Package org.a2aproject.sdk.transport.grpc.handler

Class GrpcHandler

java.lang.Object
org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.A2AServiceGrpc.A2AServiceImplBase
org.a2aproject.sdk.transport.grpc.handler.GrpcHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.grpc.BindableService, A2AServiceGrpc.AsyncService
Direct Known Subclasses:
QuarkusGrpcHandler
@Vetoed public abstract class GrpcHandler extends A2AServiceGrpc.A2AServiceImplBase
gRPC transport handler for processing A2A protocol requests.

This abstract class implements the gRPC service interface for the A2A protocol, handling both unary (blocking) and server streaming RPC calls. It translates gRPC requests to A2A protocol operations, coordinates with the request handler and agent executor, and manages error handling with appropriate gRPC status codes.

Request Flow

 gRPC Request → GrpcHandler (this class)
     ↓
 Protobuf → Domain conversion
     ↓
 RequestHandler → AgentExecutor
     ↓
 Domain → Protobuf conversion
     ↓
 gRPC Response (unary or streaming)

Supported Operations

Unary RPC (blocking):

  • sendMessage(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.SendMessageRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.SendMessageResponse>) - Send message and wait for completion
  • getTask(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.GetTaskRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.Task>) - Retrieve task by ID
  • cancelTask(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.CancelTaskRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.Task>) - Cancel task execution
  • listTasks(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.ListTasksRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.ListTasksResponse>) - List tasks with filtering
  • createTaskPushNotificationConfig(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.TaskPushNotificationConfig, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.TaskPushNotificationConfig>) - Configure push notifications
  • getTaskPushNotificationConfig(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.GetTaskPushNotificationConfigRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.TaskPushNotificationConfig>) - Get push notification config
  • listTaskPushNotificationConfigs(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.ListTaskPushNotificationConfigsRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.ListTaskPushNotificationConfigsResponse>) - List push notification configs
  • deleteTaskPushNotificationConfig(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.DeleteTaskPushNotificationConfigRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<com.google.protobuf.Empty>) - Delete push notification config
  • getExtendedAgentCard(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.GetExtendedAgentCardRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.AgentCard>) - Get extended agent capabilities

Server Streaming RPC:

  • sendStreamingMessage(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.SendMessageRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.StreamResponse>) - Send message with streaming response
  • subscribeToTask(org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.SubscribeToTaskRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.StreamResponse>) - Subscribe to task events

Error Handling

A2A errors are mapped to gRPC status codes:

  • InvalidRequestError → Status.INVALID_ARGUMENT
  • MethodNotFoundError → Status.NOT_FOUND
  • TaskNotFoundError → Status.NOT_FOUND
  • InternalError → Status.INTERNAL
  • UnsupportedOperationError → Status.UNIMPLEMENTED
  • SecurityException → Status.UNAUTHENTICATED or Status.PERMISSION_DENIED

Context Access

The handler provides rich context information equivalent to Python's grpc.aio.ServicerContext:

  • getCurrentMetadata() - Request metadata (headers)
  • getCurrentMethodName() - gRPC method name
  • getCurrentPeerInfo() - Client connection details

Extension Points

Subclasses must implement:

  • getRequestHandler() - Request handler instance
  • getAgentCard() - Public agent card
  • getExtendedAgentCard() - Extended agent card (nullable)
  • getCallContextFactory() - Custom context factory (nullable)
  • getExecutor() - Executor for async operations

CDI Integration

This class is marked with @Vetoed to prevent direct CDI management. Subclasses should be CDI beans (e.g., @GrpcService in Quarkus) that inject dependencies and provide them through the abstract methods.

  • Method Details

    • sendMessage

      public void sendMessage(SendMessageRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<SendMessageResponse> responseObserver)
      Handles a unary (blocking) message send request.

      This method processes a message send request, waits for the agent to complete processing, and returns either a Task or Message in the response.

      Protocol Flow:

      1. Validate A2A protocol version and extensions
      2. Convert protobuf request to domain MessageSendParams
      3. Invoke RequestHandler.onMessageSend(org.a2aproject.sdk.spec.MessageSendParams, org.a2aproject.sdk.server.ServerCallContext)
      4. Convert domain response to protobuf SendMessageResponse
      5. Send response and complete the RPC

      Error Handling:

      • A2AError → mapped to appropriate gRPC status code
      • SecurityException → UNAUTHENTICATED or PERMISSION_DENIED
      • Throwable → INTERNAL error
      Parameters:
      request - the gRPC message send request
      responseObserver - the gRPC response stream observer

    • sendStreamingMessage

      public void sendStreamingMessage(SendMessageRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<StreamResponse> responseObserver)
      Handles a server streaming message send request.

      This method processes a message send request with streaming response, where the agent can emit multiple events (artifacts, status updates, messages) as the task progresses.

      Protocol Flow:

      1. Verify streaming capability is enabled in agent card
      2. Validate A2A protocol version and extensions
      3. Convert protobuf request to domain MessageSendParams
      4. Invoke RequestHandler.onMessageSendStream(org.a2aproject.sdk.spec.MessageSendParams, org.a2aproject.sdk.server.ServerCallContext)
      5. Subscribe to event publisher and stream responses
      6. Convert each domain event to protobuf StreamResponse
      7. Complete RPC when final event received or error occurs

      Streaming Characteristics:

      • Server streaming RPC - server sends multiple responses
      • Backpressure handled through reactive streams subscription
      • Client disconnect detection via gRPC context cancellation
      • Automatic cleanup when stream completes or errors

      Error Handling:

      • Streaming not enabled → InvalidRequestError
      • Other A2AError → mapped to appropriate gRPC status code
      • SecurityException → UNAUTHENTICATED or PERMISSION_DENIED
      • Throwable → INTERNAL error
      Parameters:
      request - the gRPC message send request
      responseObserver - the gRPC response stream observer
